name: intent skill drafts a valid intent from a complete brief
prompt: Use the intent skill. Do not ask questions: the brief is complete. Brief: engineers want `sdlc status` to also print the number of open questions in each intent. Users: engineers and product owners. Systems: the sdlc CLI only. Constraint: no new dependencies. Name the change show-open-questions. Do not write a spec or code.
check: test -f changes/0001-show-open-questions/intent.md && ! test -e changes/0001-show-open-questions/spec.md && uv run sdlc check
